title: Headstrong
about: HEADSTRONG: a 16-bit platform game where you are a big head with tiny arms and tiny feet, hopping through a bubbly bathroom. Written in Sprout, on SPROUT·16.
line: A 16-bit platform game on SPROUT·16: you are a big head with tiny feet, bouncing on bubbles, riding soap bars and head-butting cracked tiles through three bathroom rooms to a warm towel.
